description: JOIN ... USING: inner joins on a shared column, LEFT JOIN USING leaving the unmatched side NULL, and multi-column USING (a, b) matching on both keys. Converted 1:1 from features/JoinUsingTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, dept_id INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE departments (dept_id INTEGER, dept_name VARCHAR)
SELECT name, dept_name FROM employees JOIN departments USING (dept_id) ORDER BY name
CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, dept_id INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE departments (dept_id INTEGER, dept_name VARCHAR)
SELECT name, dept_name FROM employees LEFT JOIN departments USING (dept_id) ORDER BY name
CREATE TABLE t1 (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, val VARCHAR)
CREATE TABLE t2 (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, info VARCHAR)
SELECT val, info FROM t1 JOIN t2 USING (a, b)
